title: Knowledge graph of the Zenodo library "When AI Expands Human Potential" — machine-readable map (nodes, edges, lineage chains, reading guide for AI readers)
description_html:
What this is. A knowledge graph of the series index When AI Expands Human Potential (hub DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22308201): every member record is a node (its DOI), every relation the author wrote into a record's Zenodo related_identifiers is an edge (hasPart, isPartOf, continues, references, isSupplementTo…), plus version edges derived from Zenodo concept ids. Built from live Zenodo metadata on 5 September 2026; nothing is inferred from paper content.

Files. AIHP_LIBRARY_KG.md — reading guide written for AI and human readers (relation vocabulary, lineage chains oldest→newest, member table, traversal recipes, what not to infer, a Mermaid diagram); aihp_kg.json — nodes + edges, JSON-LD flavoured (@id = DOI URL); aihp_kg_edges.jsonl — one edge per line; aihp_kg.svg/.png/.pdf — layered render, rows = publication month, latest versions only.

Readout, not truth. The graph is a diagram of the metadata as fetched on the build date. Edge counts are not importance; each record's own status line (K0, not peer reviewed, claim tiers) is the claim ceiling. Generator: scripts/zenodo_library_kg.py in the glosa repository (10.5281/zenodo.22301059), CC BY 4.0; re-run it to rebuild the graph after the library changes.
